intro: Bosnia and Herzegovina's economy is still recovering from war, relying on industry, energy and money sent home from abroad.

chapters.title: Industry and energy
text: Hydropower and coal produce electricity for export. Wood, furniture and metal products are important, and tourism to Sarajevo and Mostar is growing.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Unemployment, corruption and emigration are big problems, and money sent home by Bosnians working abroad supports many families.

keyTerms.meaning: Money sent home by people working abroad.
